test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the question. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of persons.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d37976ca84fe0a65ebfb7fe3acfd502d216d6518efb71bd9b894a62c31ddc394.png] 

Which of the following statements is correct on the basis of the above diagram?

options.text: The number of girls who are also gymnasts is 41.
The number of gymnasts who are also medal winners is 34.
The number of medal winners who are also girls is 27.
The number of girls who are neither gymnasts nor medal winners is 23.

solution:
**Given Diagram Analysis:**

The Venn diagram shows the distribution of persons among three categories: Medal winners, Gymnasts, and Girls.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d37976ca84fe0a65ebfb7fe3acfd502d216d6518efb71bd9b894a62c31ddc394.png] 

 
• **Medal winners only:** 12
 
• **Gymnasts only:** 23
 
• **Girls only:** 25
 
• **Medal winners and Gymnasts only (not Girls):** 8
 
• **Medal winners and Girls only (not Gymnasts):** 16
 
• **Gymnasts and Girls only (not Medal winners):** 14
 
• **Medal winners, Gymnasts, and Girls (all three):** 11

**Evaluating Each Statement:**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

 
• Girls who are also gymnasts = (Girls and Gymnasts only) + (Girls, Gymnasts, and Medal winners)
 
• ⇒ 14 + 11 = 25
 
• Therefore, statement 1 is **Incorrect**.

2) The number of gymnasts who are also medal winners is 34.

 
• Gymnasts who are also medal winners = (Gymnasts and Medal winners only) + (Girls, Gymnasts, and Medal winners)
 
• ⇒ 8 + 11 = 19
 
• Therefore, statement 2 is **Incorrect**.

**3) The number of medal winners who are also girls is 27.**

 
• Medal winners who are also girls = (Medal winners and Girls only) + (Girls, Gymnasts, and Medal winners)
 
• ⇒ 16 + 11 = 27
 
• Therefore, statement 3 is **Correct**.

4) The number of girls who are neither gymnasts nor medal winners is 23.

 
• Girls who are neither gymnasts nor medal winners = Girls only
 
• ⇒ 25
 
• Therefore, statement 4 is **Incorrect**.

**The correct statement based on the diagram is: The number of medal winners who are also girls is 27.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
